## Activity

Oakridge Primary Care recorded 88 captures during December 2024. This provides the activity total for the reporting period and should be used as the basis for reviewing the image quality and grading results below. The recorded volume indicates the number of captures completed at the site during the month.

## Image quality

Image quality was sufficient for grading in most cases. However, 3 captures were ungradable, representing an ungradable rate of 3.4 per cent. The clinic lead asks that recurring camera issues are logged with the service desk. This will support the identification and follow-up of equipment or image acquisition problems that may affect grading.

## Grading

There were 15 referable results among the captures reviewed. The median lag from capture to grading was 10 days. This measure reflects the typical time between the image being captured and the grading outcome being recorded. Activity, image quality and grading should continue to be monitored together so that any recurring issues can be identified and addressed through the appropriate service arrangements.
